where.if: AND (D.DEVICE_NAME LIKE '%' || || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR A.ALARM_MESSAGE LIKE '%' || || '%' ESCAPE '\')
AND A.OCCURRED_AT < CAST(#{searchDateTo} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 day'

mapper.select: SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ALARM) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST((SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ALARM_ID), 0) FROM TB_ALARM) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ALARM_CHECK) AS VARCHAR)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ALARM WHERE ALARM_ID = #{alarmId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ALARM_CHECK (ALARM_ID, USER_ID, CHECKED_AT) VALUES (#{alarmId}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (ALARM_ID, USER_ID) DO NOTHING
